interlocks.why: crane lift only with the Ausleger back: lifting with the fork in a shelf

interlocks.reason: no switch says 'at a slot': it would need an encoder comparator - left to the program

interlocks.why: VGR swivel only at transit height, above everything on the table
interlocks.reason: blocks 36 of 49 program steps, e.g. arm 'rise to transit height'; it would have passed the Upgrade 7 program - Upgrade 10's blended path swings below transit

attacks.name: compromised PLC drives the crane sideways with the fork in a shelf
attacks.u11: allowed: the PLC is the one source the allow-list trusts - a compromised PLC is allowed to write Q4 - only a hardwired interlock stops that (finding F2)
attacks.u12: blocked in hardware: IL1's contact is open while I6 is not made, so Q3/Q4 cannot be powered - 0 mm, against 13.5 mm with detection alone

attacks.name: writable coils the program never uses
attacks.u11: vgr.Q7, oven.Q10, sorting.Q2 wired to live coils (blocked by the allow-list only)
attacks.u12: unwired: 0 unused outputs left on the register map; the allow-list still passes least privilege (OK) with 19 rules

attacks.name: guard locks released by the PLC alone
attacks.u11: a compromised PLC could unlock a door while the actuators are powered
attacks.u12: the release needs the PLC's request AND K8's 0 V: 26628 safety-logic states checked, no violations

forged.note: U9: a long enough forged window drains to the 10 % floor; U12: the window stops at the reserve

findings.title: 5 of 8 jog rules are now hardwired
findings.text: Each adopted interlock uses a switch or reed the machine already has, and replaying the whole order step by step shows it never blocks the program. A command from the network - even the PLC's own - can no longer drive into them.

findings.title: Upgrade 10's faster path rules one interlock out
findings.text: blocks 36 of 49 program steps, e.g. arm 'rise to transit height'; it would have passed the Upgrade 7 program - Upgrade 10's blended path swings below transit. Throughput and hard limits pull against each other; the swivel stays guarded by the swept-path proof and the program.

findings.title: 3 rules stay in software, for a reason each
findings.text: IL2: blocks 36 of 109 program steps, e.g. crane 'lift to row'; IL3: no switch says 'at a slot': it would need an encoder comparator - left to the program; IL4: blocks 36 of 49 program steps, e.g. arm 'rise to transit height'; it would have passed the Upgrade 7 program - Upgrade 10's blended path swings below transit

findings.title: Holding the reserve costs nothing this month
findings.text: The month's real DR events never took the battery below 31 %, so the new floor changes nothing in them: demand response met, bill €6.35, ride-through 10/10 either way. It bites only on a longer event - or a forged one, which under U9 could drain the battery to 10 % and now leaves the full 200 Wh reserve.

findings.title: No new sensors: five relays and one monitor
findings.text: 5 interface relays on the node rails and one standstill monitor K8 in the cabinet; the nodes were re-placed and re-cleared with the relays on them.
